name: @nikon-uvc-ptp-bridge/desktop
description: Electron desktop shell for the Nikon UVC-PTP bridge

scripts.build:win: electron-vite build && electron-builder --win zip --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/win-x64 && electron-builder --win zip --arm64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/win-arm64
scripts.build:linux: electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux tar.gz --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/linux-x64-tgz && electron-builder --linux tar.gz --arm64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/linux-arm64-tgz && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/linux-x64-deb && electron-builder --linux deb --arm64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/linux-arm64-deb
scripts.build:mac: electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac zip --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/mac-x64 && electron-builder --mac zip --arm64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/mac-arm64

author: AMDphreak
